channel.title: Times of San Diego - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Times of San Diego (timesofsandiego.com)

item.title: Opinion: It’s fitting that San Diego will host 2028 Olympic soccer matches
item.description: Here’s hoping that the Olympic soccer matches in 2028 bring good memories to a new generation of San Diegans as did the equestrian event in 1984.

item.title: San Diego Ballet to highlight San Diego Museum of Art’s century through dance
item.description: The museum and San Diego Ballet company’s relationship is closer than ever for the museum’s centennial year.

item.title: DOJ looks to automatically dismiss immigration appeals
item.description: A new entry to the Federal Register is meant to speed the rate of decisions at the Board of Immigration Appeals.

item.title: Dozens arrested in crackdown on open air drug markets in East Village
item.description: The cross-agency ‘Operation Street Sweeper’ targeted illegal drug markets in East Village with the goal to dismantle the open sale of substances like fentanyl, meth and crack cocaine.

item.title: San Diego County’s longest-serving GOP city official seeks re-election as Democrat
item.description: Gary Kendrick, an El Cajon City Councilman since 2002, Monday announced he has formally left the Republican Party and will run for re-election as a Democrat.

item.title: Summery stretch ends with cooler temps, midweek rain in San Diego County
item.description: San Diego County's run of warm, dry weather is ending, with cooler-than-average conditions, gusty winds and rain expected this week, according to the National Weather Service.

item.title: Seven things to do in middle San Diego this month
item.description: From Mission Valley to Mission Trails, here are seven events that may be worth your while this month.

item.title: After 57 years, The Black goes to ‘hippie heaven’ — behind the store’s closure and the countercultural space it created
item.description: The Black held the essence of what defined a generation of draft-dodgers, rockers and hippies. After 57 years it has become too expensive to maintain.

item.title: San Diego County initiates health inspection at Otay Mesa Detention Center
item.description: San Diego County has begun the public health inspection process at the Otay Mesa Detention Center following reports of concerning conditions inside the privately operated immigration facility.

item.title: Federal judge blocks California ban on ICE face coverings, IDs still required
item.description: A federal judge on Monday blocked a California law from going into effect that would ban federal immigration agents from covering their faces, but they will still be required to wear clear identification showing their agency and badge number.
